assets.name: apple-tree
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. A polished natural-looking 3D storybook illustration sprite for a counting game for ages 2–3. Soft tactile textures, natural proportions, warm gentle daylight, clear recognisable silhouette, friendly family game quality rather than a flat geometric icon. Entire subject fully visible, tightly framed with a small safe margin. Isolated on a genuinely transparent background with clean alpha edges. No text, no numerals, no frame, no people, no extra objects. One healthy apple-tree asset with a sturdy warm brown branching trunk and a broad rounded lush leafy green canopy. IMPORTANT: there must be NO apples, no fruit anywhere. The game overlays exactly counted draggable apples later. Front view, canopy broad enough for five large apples to be overlaid in its central area, trunk reaching the bottom, only a tiny tuft of grass at the base. Vertical rectangular composition.
